reports.title: ConocoPhillips announces third-quarter 2026 results and increases quarterly ordinary dividend by 11%

guidance.heading: Outlook
section: Fourth-quarter 2026 production is expected to be 2.32 to 2.36 million barrels of oil equivalent per day. Full-year capital expenditures and adjusted operating cost guidance remain unchanged. Additional guidance items can be found on slide 11 of the company’s third-quarter 2026 earnings presentation, available on the company’s investor relations website.

ConocoPhillips will host a conference call today at 12:00 p.m. Eastern time to discuss this announcement. To listen to the call and view related presentation materials and supplemental information, go to www.conocophillips.com/investor. A recording and transcript of the call will be posted afterward.
